title: fix(scripts): dispatch-gates derives the name-fold loader gate for every file under the roots it walks
body:
Fixes #24037
Clause-②: no

The dispatch derivation now names `node scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs` (and its `--self-test`) for a change to any file under the roots that gate walks. The fix is in the gate's own source: its roots become the `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` literal the derivation already reads, and the walk is derived from that literal. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` are **unchanged**: no new gate, row, ratchet, `--tier` mandate or constant (ruling 6243472660, term 3).

## What changed

- **`scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs`.** The walked roots are now one exported literal, `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS = ['packages/**', 'examples/**', 'apps/**', 'scripts/**', '.github/**']`. `SCAN_ROOTS` is derived from it, so the walk and the declaration are one list and cannot drift. The one root not carried over is `tools`: the tree has no `tools/` directory (0 tracked files). The scan count is unchanged at 10263 files before and after. A declared root the tree does not have would print as a dead lead on every card the gate matches.
- **`scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs`.** The four `REFUSE-WIDE` verdicts on this gate's `SCAN_ROOTS` rows (packages, examples, apps, scripts; measured 2026-08-31) are withdrawn. Once `SCAN_ROOTS` is derived, the bare-word literals they judged no longer exist, so the self-test's STALE remedy applies: "Delete the entry; do not re-point it at another row". A comment in their place names the ruling and the measured consumer. The declaration battery registers two cases per recorded row, so its floor follows the row count: 128 to 126 (134 to 126 on a run). One docblock sentence that cited the withdrawn 99% row is annotated. **This file is outside the claim's declared file surface.** The edit is forced: with the gate change alone, this self-test exits 1 with 5 failures (the STALE case plus four attribution cases).
- **`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`.** One fast-tier block, against the live tree, for both invocations of the gate. It reads one probe per declared subtree root off the family's own extracted hints, plus the exact path PR #24028 edited (`scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`), and each must be MATCHED. In-place ablation: with the subtree hints stripped, the PR #24028 path and a brand-new package file both read `silent`. A floor case requires at least five subtree roots, so the loop cannot run zero times.

## The mechanism, measured (the card marked it "likely, not confirmed")

- **Half right.** The extractor (`extractWatchHints`) keys on **no** constant name and **no** `export`. It reads every quoted, path-shaped literal in the module body. The gate's roots were invisible because they were **bare single-segment words**, which `looksPathy` refuses: `extractWatchHints("const X = 'packages';")` yields `[]`. `'.github'` is dotted and was already read. So `SCAN_ROOTS` being private was not the cause; the spelling was. `check:watch-hint-literal` constrains the declaration to a literal array of admissible literals, and the new one passes (`--list` shows it).
- **The miss was recorded, not accidental.** `bare-root-worklist.mjs` held four `REFUSE-WIDE` verdicts on exactly these rows: the declaration would be true, and was refused for the precision of the matched column. Three things decide it here:
  - Ruling 6243472660 term 3 names this conversion for this gate.
  - The worklist's own CONTRADICTED and STALE remedy text allows withdrawing the verdict when the declaration is deliberate and overrides the refusal.
  - This row has the measured consumer that the worklist's 2026-08-26 re-adjudication used as its criterion: PR #24028, a local union of 98/98 that went red in CI.
- **Precision cost.** The gate is now MATCHED for every tracked file under the five roots: 10343 of 12129 tracked files (85%; packages 9545, examples 265, apps 51, scripts 437, .github 45), in both invocations. One run takes 2.4 s wall.

## Derivation, before and after

| probe | `f5ef054a` | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--commands scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` (the PR #24028 miss) | 28 commands, no name-fold gate | 30 commands; the diff is exactly the two name-fold commands |
| `--commands` on the four card paths (`dispatch-gates.mjs`, `.data.mjs`, `.self-test.mjs`, the gate) | 33 commands | n/a (the derivation files are not in this diff) |
| `--commands` with no paths (this diff, 3 files) | — | 32 commands, listed under Verification |

## Census (acceptance 2)

**Population, by reading.** Every gate's population constant, read by `node scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs`, the derivation-coupled instrument for this exact species (a population constant holding a bare top-level word the extractor reads nothing for). Its `--wide` sweep is the unrestricted contrast, and its CENSUS map holds the fs-trace census of computed roots. Each root's placement below is the derivation's own `placeFamily` verdict for a brand-new file under that root, read on this branch.

Queries over `scripts/*.mjs` and `scripts/pm/*.mjs` on this branch (files hit; controls first):
- control `isEntrypoint`: 213 · control `readFileSync`: 255
- `readdirSync|readdir\(`: 146 · `\bwalk[A-Za-z]*\(`: 99 · `'ls-files'`: 32 · `SCAN_ROOTS?\b`: 25 · `\bROOTS\b`: 22
- `^(export )?const [A-Z_]*_WATCH_HINTS =` (existing declarations under `scripts/`): 60 at `f5ef054a`, 61 here. `check:watch-hint-literal --list` prints 75 declarations repo-wide.
- Bare-root worklist (restricted): 82 rows, 47 gate source files at `f5ef054a`; 78 rows, 46 files here. Wide contrast sweep: 140 pairs, 84 files at `f5ef054a`; 136 pairs, 83 files here. The diff in both sweeps is exactly the four name-fold rows.

**Answer: yes, other gates keep roots the same undeclared way. One is converted in this PR; every other is already read or is listed below with its reason. No row was added to `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`.**

Measured "not a population": `check-console-injection` ×2, `check-doc-frontmatter` · docs, `check-doc-security-posture` · docs | **listed.** The worklist forbids the pass that sees a row from judging it |

Of the 34 extra files: 8 are the CENSUS families in the row above; `check-self-test-wired` walks `scripts` and declares `scripts/**/*.mjs`, `.mts` and `.sh` (already read); these 11 are listed; the other 14 hold the word as a data key, a baseline path built by `join`, a self-test fixture or path parsing, not a walked root |

**The three earlier instances the card names, read today** (`--commands` on real files):
- `check:error-status-conformance`: derived for `packages/metadata/src/loaders/ambiguous-metadata-stem.ts` through its HTTP-status content kind. Its `SCAN_ROOT packages` row stays REFUSE-WIDE.
- `check:durability-log-level`: derived for `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` through its durability content kind and its declared scan surface.
- `check:i18n-coverage`: derived for `examples/app-showcase/src/data/analytics/showcase.cube.ts` through its declared examples hints. Its packages half stays SPELLABLE-UNDECLARED and is reached through the extract-config convention trigger.

## Verification

All readings below are on this branch's final head, **`cf4e110f`** (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), with no commit after them.

- **Derived local subset.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths (the change set came from git: 3 files vs merge base `f5ef054a7`) derived 32 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 32 exited **0**. `pnpm check:declared-population-live` was also run beyond the union, because this diff adds a declaration; it exited 0 (268 of 330 families declare a population, all live).
- **Reconciliation.** `--ran` printed `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 32 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 32 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`, with exit 0.

  - `… --self-test` → `39 cases pass` (exit 0).

  - `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (the fast tier, as CI runs it on a PR) → `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1902 cases pass` (exit 0, 384 s).

- **Other local gates, all exit 0:** `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (both), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-declaration-mirrors` (both), `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` (both), `check-self-test-wired` (both), `check-self-test-workflow-commands` (both), `check-whole-set-label-write` (both), `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:bash32-floor`, `check:cli-command-ids`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes` (12120 text files, no control bytes), `check:parse-guard`, `check:pnpm-filter-targets`, `check:pnpm-flag-spellings`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:refd-timer-probe`.

## Acceptance notes

- The `tools` root dropped from the walk is a behaviour delta only for a tree that grows a top-level `tools/`. Today it is a no-op: 10263 files are scanned before and after. A future `tools/` would need a declared root, as any other new root would.
- The derivation files need no change: the extractor reads the new literal as it stands. The self-test block is the only `dispatch-gates*` edit, and #24073's job-condition rendering is untouched.
- Test files `git grep` finds naming an edited script: none read one. `packages/spec/src/system/compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` and `packages/types/src/driver-error-classification.callers.test.ts` mention the dispatch-gates self-test in prose only, so they are not owed a run.
